caseName: Tuan Anh Nguyen v. Immigration & Naturalization Service
caseNameFull: Tuan Anh Nguyen v. Immigration and Naturalization Service

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, November 13,2000. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, December 13, 2000. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, December 29, 2000. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
